Comment: Post-approval execution: Guardian -> Chronicler. Started by an EventBridge rule on approval.approved events from the dashboard. Step Functions cannot resume a finished execution mid-machine, so an approved irreversible remediation runs here rather than in the main pipeline — the same two Lambdas, entered at the point the human unblocked.

Guardian.Comment: Execute the approved remediation. The decision payload already carries tier=auto, because a human supplied the authority the tier gate was withholding.

Chronicler.Comment: Score the trial and apply the lifecycle, exactly as on the unattended path. An approved execution is a trial like any other.

ApprovedRunFailed.Cause: An approved remediation failed after retries. The approval row records who authorized it and when; see the execution history and the failed task's CloudWatch logs.
